parts.text: Edit this image: remove the buzz-saw weed whacker (the gold saw blade and its shaft) from behind his shoulder completely. Instead, strap TWO tall polished chrome air tanks side by side on his back, upright, with gold valves and hoses running into his armor, the tank tops visible above his shoulders. Keep his gold mask, chrome axe on his shoulder, blue-flame chrome machete, armored cyborg body, the space shuttle background and the clay style exactly the same.
